Backend guard '...complete at least one service or upload evidence' returns 400 with detail; frontend modal does surface this via error.response.data.detail - good
server.py still 1100+ lines - prior recommendation to split into routers remains
seed_data_creation: Used existing seed; auto-completed one pending service on chosen in_progress case (INV000075) to satisfy backend submission guard. Test data observations/conclusion prefixed with 'TEST_' or 'UI TEST'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Findings submission bug is FIXED. Backend requires at least one completed service OR uploaded evidence before findings can be submitted (returns 400 otherwise). Frontend handleSubmitFindings now correctly accepts formData param. Test cases used: INV000075 via UI (now submitted), INV000010 already submitted, INV000034 referenced in problem statement. To find a testable in_progress case, prefer one with a completed service or first mark a pending service complete via PUT /api/investigations/{id}/services/{sid}.
rca of the issue: Root cause was previously identified: frontend handleSubmitFindings referenced an undefined 'findingsForm' variable causing silent failures. Fix verified: handler now accepts formData from SubmitFindingsModal callback and posts to /api/investigations/{id}/findings. All four originally reported issues are resolved: (1) findings persist, (2) status moves in_progress->submitted, (3) timeline shows correct 'findings submitted' event, (4) list/workbench reflect new status after navigation.
